method: Two complete pinned files read. Four original helper methods AST-extracted with class base removed; stdlib control executed3216 single-range boundary cases and targeted overlap/order/UTF8 cases. No external tool execution.

longest merge preserves overlapping ranges not contained in previous. duplicate_size sums individual lengths and overcounts overlap: ranges0..10 and1..11 report20duplicate bytes while cleanup removes11. Exact cleanup output lmnopqrst from20ASCIIbytes confirmed.

restore assumes ascending segment order without sorting/validation. Segments15..18 then0..5 across documents0..10 and10..20 restore only latter-document5..8 and lose first-document0..5. Real external collector ordering remains unverified.

clean_up works in UTF8byte offsets then decode(errors=ignore); removing first byte of éX yields X, silently dropping remaining partial character byte. Actual external ranges may or may not align to character boundaries; no full pipeline claim.

main concatenates documents without separators and clips returned ranges to document boundaries before length-threshold filtering. Cross-document repeat matches are possible in concatenated source; correctness depends on external collector contract not yet reviewed.

main unconditionally removes/recreates configured cache directory plus output/tmp under external repo before loading data; these are shared fixed paths and no run isolation or finally cleanup is shown. Review only: no removal/external command executed.

run_command captures stdout/stderr, checks return code and raises diagnostic error. No timeout or cancellation is passed, and full stdout/stderr buffered. These are lifecycle/scalability observations, not measured failure.
